data.title: Unit 2 : The Animal World
Types of Animals
data.text: The eyes help one to see the world around.
Light rays fall on an object and bounce back to the eye.
These rays enter the eye and fall on the retina to form an image of that object.
When the eye sees the object, it appears to be upside down.
It is the brain that turns the image the right way around.
The eyelids close quickly if the brain senses danger to our eyes.
The eyelashes trap dust and other tiny particles from getting into our eyes.
Our eyes remain the same size all through our life.
It is the brain that turns the image the right way around.
